python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('/home/edbert-chan/.invoker/invoker.db', timeout=20)
c.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=20000")
q="select id,status,execution_agent,pool_id from tasks where is_merge_node=1 and status not in ('completed','skipped','cancelled')"
rows=list(c.execute(q))
print("  before:")
for r in rows: print(f"    {r[0]:34s} {r[1]:14s} agent={r[2]} pool={r[3]}")
c.execute("""update tasks set execution_agent='claude', pool_id='local-claude'
             where is_merge_node=1 and status not in ('completed','skipped','cancelled')""")
c.commit()
print(f"\n  rows updated: {c.total_changes}")
print("  after:")
for r in c.execute(q): print(f"    {r[0]:34s} {r[1]:14s} agent={r[2]} pool={r[3]}")
c.close()
PY
